code_improvements.title: Add Production Module Dashboard
code_improvements.description: Create a dashboard view for the Production module with statistics about production orders, batches, bins, and recent activity - similar to the existing inventory and purchasing dashboards.
code_improvements.rationale: The code reveals this opportunity because: 1) Dashboard pattern already exists in inventory/views.py dashboard() and purchasing/views.py dashboard(), 2) Production module has all the necessary models (ProductionOrder, Batch, Bin) with status fields and timestamps, 3) Statistics queries using Count, Sum, and aggregations are well-established patterns in the codebase, 4) Template structure exists (templates/dashboard/index.html, templates/inventory/dashboard.html) that can be followed.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create dashboard() view in apps/production/views.py following the exact pattern from inventory/views.py:dashboard() - stats dict with order counts by status, batch counts by status, total bins, recent movements. 2. Add URL route in apps/production/urls.py. 3. Create templates/production/dashboard.html extending base/internal.html with stat cards and recent activity tables following templates/inventory/dashboard.html structure.

code_improvements.title: Add Supplier Search API Endpoint
code_improvements.description: Create an AJAX search API endpoint for suppliers, allowing typeahead/autocomplete functionality when selecting suppliers in forms - similar to the existing material_search_api.
code_improvements.rationale: The code reveals this opportunity because: 1) material_search_api() exists in materials/views.py and returns JSON for autocomplete, 2) Supplier model is fully defined with searchable fields (name, code, cnpj), 3) api_materials_with_stock() and api_warehouses() show the API endpoint pattern is well-established, 4) Several forms require supplier selection (purchase requests, purchase orders) that would benefit from search.
existing_patterns: material_search_api() with Q filter on multiple fields
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Copy material_search_api() function in materials/views.py, rename to supplier_search_api(). 2. Modify query to filter Supplier model on Q(name__icontains=query) | Q(code__icontains=query) | Q(cnpj__icontains=query). 3. Return id, code, name, contact_email fields in results. 4. Add URL path in materials/urls.py: path('api/suppliers/search/', views.supplier_search_api, name='supplier_search_api').

code_improvements.title: Add Reports View to Production Module
code_improvements.description: Create a reports view for the Production module showing production order statistics, batch throughput, bin utilization, and material consumption over configurable time periods - following the existing inventory reports pattern.
code_improvements.rationale: The code reveals this opportunity because: 1) Reports view pattern exists in inventory/views.py reports() with date range filtering, 2) Production models have all necessary data fields (status, dates, quantities) for meaningful reports, 3) Aggregation queries using Sum, Count, values() are well-established, 4) templates/inventory/reports.html provides the template structure to follow.
existing_patterns: Date range filtering with date_from/date_to GET params
Default to last 30 days if no date specified
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create reports() view in apps/production/views.py following inventory/views.py:reports() - accept date_from/date_to params, default to 30 days. 2. Query ProductionOrder for orders_by_status, completed orders count, avg completion time. 3. Query Batch for batches by status, total quantity produced. 4. Query BinHistory for material flow statistics. 5. Add URL and create template extending base/internal.html with charts/tables.

code_improvements.title: Add Date Range Filter to Material and Supplier Lists
code_improvements.description: Add date range filtering (date_from, date_to) to material_list and supplier_list views, allowing users to filter by creation date - extending the existing date filter pattern from inventory movements.
code_improvements.rationale: The code reveals this opportunity because: 1) Date range filter pattern exists in inventory/views.py movements_list() and production/views.py bin_list(), 2) Material and Supplier models have created_at field from BaseModel, 3) The filter UI pattern is established in the codebase, 4) material_list and supplier_list already have search and type filters, just missing date range.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. In materials/views.py material_list(), add date_from/date_to GET params following movements_list pattern. 2. Add filter: if date_from: materials = materials.filter(created_at__date__gte=date_from). 3. Same for date_to with __lte. 4. Add to context dict. 5. Update template to include date input fields in filter form. 6. Repeat for supplier_list().

code_improvements.title: Add Bulk Status Change for Production Orders
code_improvements.description: Add bulk operations capability to change status of multiple production orders at once (start multiple, complete multiple) - extending the existing bulk operations pattern from bin batch printing.
code_improvements.rationale: The code reveals this opportunity because: 1) Bulk operations pattern exists in production/views.py bin_batch_create() and bin_batch_print() with transaction.atomic(), 2) ProductionOrder has start() and complete() methods that can be called in a loop, 3) AJAX endpoint pattern with JsonResponse for bulk ops is established, 4) The list view already shows multiple orders that could be selected.
existing_patterns: bin_batch_print with json.loads(request.body) for IDs list
Result tracking dict with success count and errors list
Checkbox selection in list template for bulk ops
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create production_order_bulk_start(request) in views.py accepting order_ids JSON array. 2. Use transaction.atomic() to iterate orders, call order.start(request.user), track success/errors. 3. Return JsonResponse with counts. 4. Create production_order_bulk_complete() similarly. 5. Add URL paths. 6. Update production_order_list.html to add checkbox selection column and bulk action buttons following bin_list.html pattern.
